notes_for_editor: Thin record. Specific facts come from the FFLA list (name, county, coordinates, gone) and Mapcarta (tower type, Rainbow Fire Tower alias, 481 m, drawing on OpenStreetMap). The 'Rainbow Fire Tower' alias also appears on anyplaceamerica.com, but that page returned 403 and was only seen as a search snippet, so it is not cited. Consider adding 'Rainbow Fire Tower' to other_names after a second check. Forest Lookouts lists only 'Florence County' for this site, with no agency. No build date, design, height, staffing or removal date found. A Wisconsin Historical Society AHI record surfaced for Florence County (ref 22555) but it is for the Buckeye tower, not this one, and was not used. Next steps: Florence County and Wisconsin DNR records for dates and fate.
